subtitle: Lesson 17 · Scaling & Reliability

code:
CPU-based scaling (common default):
  scale out when avg CPU > 70%

AI inference workload:
  CPU near-idle, GPU pegged at 100%
  -> CPU scaling never triggers,
     even though the service IS saturated
caption: GPU utilization or queue depth reflect load; CPU often doesn't, for inference.

steps.label: Min instances
steps.sub: never below this -- protects against cold starts

steps.label: Max instances
steps.sub: never above this -- protects budget and GPU quota

code:
Typical web instance:   starts in SECONDS
GPU-backed instance:    starts in MINUTES
  (bigger image, weights load into GPU memory,
   driver init, GPU availability itself)
caption: Scale in bigger, less frequent steps -- and lean on the min floor for short bursts.
